title: China fires rockets near Taiwan in major live-fire military drills on video
description: China Taiwan military drills see rockets fired into waters near island during largest encirclement exercise in eight months. Chinese forces staged 'Justice Mission 2025'.

title: Taiwan detects 130 Chinese aircraft, 14 vessels amid major military drills
description: TAIPEI, Dec 30: Taiwan’s Ministry of National Defense said that it has detected a spike in Chinese military activity around the island, detecting 130 People’s Liberation Army (PLA) aircraft, 14 naval vessels, and eight official ships in surrounding airspace and waters as of Tuesday morning. Of the aircraft, 90 crossed the Taiwan Strait median line, entering Taiwan’s northern, central, southwestern, and eastern Air Defense Identification Zones (ADIZ). The latest activity comes amid large-scale joint military drills launched by China on […]

title: US Senator warns China intensifying Taiwan invasion rehearsals
description: TAIPEI, Dec 30: US Senator Roger Wicker has said that China has intensified rehearsals to invade Taiwan, warning that the drills are designed to demonstrate the People’s Liberation Army’s (PLA) ability to impose a blockade and allow the Chinese Communist Party to coerce Taipei. “China’s rehearsals for an invasion of Taiwan continue to intensify. description: China's People's Liberation Army is conducting large-scale military drills around Taiwan as part of "Justice Mission 2025."

title: New Pentagon Maps Show the Reach of China's Expanding Missile Force
description: China's missile arsenal can strike targets around Taiwan, across the Indo-Pacific, and even in the continental US. The maps paint a clear picture.

title: China's Show of Force: War Games Around Taiwan
description: China conducted extensive military drills around Taiwan, showcasing its military prowess with live-fire exercises and assault ship deployments. These actions follow the U.S. announcement of a significant arms package for Taiwan. The drills aim to deter external intervention and raise tensions in East Asia.
